verdict: Fortive's revenue rose 8% to $1.11B, led by Intelligent Operating Solutions at +10%, and GAAP profit rose 47% to $173M — helped by an $18M tariff refund booked in the quarter.

segments.name: Intelligent Operating Solutions
segments.note: Instruments, sensors and workflow software for industrial and facility operations (Fluke, Tektronix and peers) — core revenue up 9.1%.

segments.name: Advanced Healthcare Solutions
segments.note: Sterilization, infection-prevention and healthcare workflow products (ASP, Provation) — core revenue up 3.1%, with segment profit down as mix shifted.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the two businesses — Fortive's largest cost line.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Product development across instruments, sensors and healthcare technology.

otherDetail: Interest expense, net of $38.8M, partly offset by $5.2M of other non-operating income.
footerNote: Figures are for continuing operations (Fortive spun off its Precision Technologies business as Ralliant in 2025; it is excluded from all periods shown).

takeaways.title: The industrial side is carrying growth
takeaways.text: Intelligent Operating Solutions grew 9.8% with a 29.1% GAAP operating margin, while Advanced Healthcare Solutions grew 3.7% and its segment operating profit fell 10% on mix.

takeaways.title: A tariff refund flattered the quarter
takeaways.text: After the Supreme Court struck down the IEEPA tariffs, Fortive booked an $18.0M refund recovery inside cost of sales. It is excluded from adjusted results — one reason GAAP EPS rose 63% while adjusted EPS rose 13%.

takeaways.title: Buybacks are the capital story
takeaways.text: Fortive spent about $300M repurchasing roughly 5M shares — about 2% of the share count — in a single quarter, funded by $313M of operating cash flow.

oneTimers: An $18.0M IEEPA tariff-refund recovery is included in cost of sales (and therefore in gross profit); Fortive excludes it from adjusted earnings.
A $6.2M non-cash impairment of capitalized software and $4.9M of foreign-currency gains on euro-denominated debt also sit inside the GAAP figures.
